svg.text: DETAIL 7 / A6.01 — GREEN ROOF EDGE AT FOUNDATION WALL
100% CD MARK-UP — NOTES TO ADD (TEXT AS SHOWN) + DRAWING ELEMENTS TO ADD
= DRAWING ELEMENT MISSING FROM THE CURRENT DETAIL — DRAW IT, THEN NOTE IT.
SLOPE TO DRAIN
EXT.
INT.
R3
C1
FIN. GRADE / T.O. MEDIA EL. = ___
T.O. STRUCT. SLAB EL. = ___
GRAVEL MAINTENANCE / VEGETATION-FREE
STRIP, 1'-6" MIN. WIDE — WASHED ROUNDED
STONE, 1/2"–1" DIA., OVER FILTER FABRIC.
EDGE RESTRAINT — PERFORATED ALUM. OR
STAINLESS, SET ON PROTECTION LAYER. NO
FASTENERS THROUGH MEMBRANE.
ROOF DRAIN + OVERFLOW BEYOND, W/ DRAIN
INSPECTION CHAMBER — SEE PLUMBING AND
ROOF PLAN.
FINISH GRADE — SLOPE AWAY FROM BUILDING 5% MIN. FOR
10'-0". SEE CIVIL DRAWINGS FOR GRADING.
SOIL BACKFILL AND COMPACTION PER GEOTECHNICAL REPORT.
DO NOT BACKFILL UNTIL DECK HAS CURED AND IS BRACED /
SHORED PER STRUCTURAL.
PREFABRICATED DRAINAGE COMPOSITE W/ INTEGRAL FILTER
FABRIC — CONTINUOUS FROM ROOF DRAINAGE COURSE TO
FOOTING DRAIN, NO BREAK AT TRANSITION.
RIGID INSULATION (XPS) CONTINUOUS DOWN EXTERIOR FACE
OF FOUNDATION WALL — EXTEND 2'-0" MIN. BELOW DECK TO
LAP INTERIOR INSULATION AND CLOSE THE THERMAL BRIDGE
AT THE SLAB EDGE.
BELOW-GRADE WATERPROOFING — SAME MFR. / SYSTEM AS ROOF
MEMBRANE, CONTINUOUS OVER TOP OF WALL AND DOWN FACE.
2-PLY REINFORCING AT ALL CORNERS AND TRANSITIONS.
WATERSTOP AT HORIZONTAL CONSTRUCTION JOINT — SEE
STRUCTURAL AND WATERPROOFING MFR.
CONCRETE FOUNDATION WALL — SEE STRUCTURAL FOR
THICKNESS, REINFORCING AND JOINT LOCATIONS.
FOOTING, FOUNDATION DRAIN, FILTER FABRIC AND WASHED
GRAVEL BELOW — SEE CIVIL. ADD CROSS-REFERENCE TO
FOUNDATION DETAIL.
BELOW-GRADE WALL ASSEMBLY TAG — ADD SEPARATE 'W-__'
TAG FOR THE VERTICAL CONDITION; R3 (ROOF) SHOULD NOT
CARRY THE WALL ASSEMBLY.
PLANTINGS AND IRRIGATION — SEE LANDSCAPE DRAWINGS.
GROWING MEDIUM — DEPTH, MIX AND SATURATED UNIT
WEIGHT PER LANDSCAPE. CONFIRM LOADING W/
STRUCTURAL.
FILTER FABRIC — LAP 6" MIN. AT SEAMS; TURN UP AT
EDGE RESTRAINT AND AT BACKFILL INTERFACE.
DRAINAGE / RETENTION / AERATION COURSE — MAINTAIN
CONTINUOUS PATH TO ROOF DRAIN.
RIGID INSULATION, XPS — R-__ MIN. PER ENERGY CODE.
LOOSE-LAID, JOINTS STAGGERED (INVERTED / PROTECTED
MEMBRANE ASSEMBLY).
PROTECTION COURSE / SEPARATION SHEET OVER
MEMBRANE.
ROOT BARRIER BY MEMBRANE MFR. — CONTINUOUS, UP AND
OVER TOP OF WALL.
ROOFING / WATERPROOFING MEMBRANE — HOT FLUID-
APPLIED REINFORCED, FULLY ADHERED. FLOOD TEST AND
ELECTRONIC LEAK DETECTION PRIOR TO OVERBURDEN.
STRUCTURAL CONCRETE DECK — SLOPE 1/4" PER FT. MIN.
TO DRAIN (OR LEVEL DECK W/ TAPERED DRAINAGE COURSE
— VERIFY). SEE STRUCTURAL.
AIR / VAPOR BARRIER CONTINUITY — TRANSITION
MEMBRANE FROM ROOF MEMBRANE TO BELOW-GRADE
WATERPROOFING. SEAL ALL LAPS.
SEALANT AND FIRE-SAFING AT CEILING-TO-WALL JOINT.
CONTINUOUS RIGID INSULATION AT INTERIOR FACE OF
FOUNDATION WALL — LAP EXTERIOR INSULATION 2'-0"
MIN.
GYPSUM BOARD / INTERIOR FINISH — SEE FINISH
SCHEDULE.
GENERAL NOTES — THIS DETAIL
VEGETATED ROOF ASSEMBLY TO COMPLY W/ IBC 1507.16 AND IFC 317 — PROVIDE VEGETATION-
FREE ZONES AT PERIMETER, PENETRATIONS AND DRAINS. CLASS 'A' ASSEMBLY.
ALL VEGETATED ROOF COMPONENTS (MEMBRANE, ROOT BARRIER, PROTECTION, DRAINAGE, FILTER
FABRIC) FROM A SINGLE SOURCE MFR. UNDER ONE 20-YEAR NDL WARRANTY.
24-HOUR FLOOD TEST PER ASTM D5957 AND ELECTRONIC LEAK DETECTION PER ASTM D7877 PRIOR
TO PLACING ANY OVERBURDEN.
DO NOT PLACE OVERBURDEN UNTIL MEMBRANE IS INSPECTED AND ACCEPTED BY MFR'S
REPRESENTATIVE; SUBMIT INSPECTION REPORT.
NO PENETRATIONS OR MECHANICAL FASTENERS THROUGH WATERPROOFING MEMBRANE.
SATURATED WEIGHT OF COMPLETE ASSEMBLY = ___ PSF; VERIFY W/ STRUCTURAL BEFORE
ORDERING MATERIALS.
COORDINATE IRRIGATION SLEEVES, LEAK-DETECTION GRID AND ELECTRICAL W/ LANDSCAPE,
PLUMBING AND ELECTRICAL.
PROVIDE 4'-0" LONG MOCK-UP OF THIS EDGE CONDITION FOR REVIEW PRIOR TO PROCEEDING.
PROTECT COMPLETED MEMBRANE FROM CONSTRUCTION TRAFFIC W/ TEMPORARY PROTECTION BOARD.
VERIFY / COORDINATE BEFORE ISSUE
— MEMBRANE TYPE + SPEC SECTION NUMBER
— R-VALUE AND ENERGY-CODE COMPLIANCE PATH AT SLAB EDGE
— INTENSIVE VS. EXTENSIVE — MEDIA DEPTH AND DEAD LOAD
— SOIL RETENTION AT BACKFILL / GRAVEL INTERFACE
— DRAIN + OVERFLOW LOCATIONS SHOWN ON ROOF PLAN
— R3 / C1 TAGS AGREE W/ ASSEMBLY SCHEDULE
GREEN ROOF EDGE AT FOUNDATION WALL
